data.description:
## Observation (2026-11-09)
- docs/releasing.md, section 'Tag signing — SKIPPED', says rebar keeps annotated release tags.
- `gh api repos/navapbc/rebar/git/ref/tags/<tag>` returns object type `commit` (a lightweight tag) for v0.13.1, v0.14.0 and v0.15.0. v0.15.0 points directly at fd2cae3925e3b05992cdad5ed53e4d85128ed78c.
- The tag is created by release.yml's github_release job via `gh release create`, which makes a lightweight tag at the target SHA.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] docs/releasing.md and release.yml agree on the tag type: either the doc states lightweight tags, or github_release creates an annotated tag.
data.title: docs/releasing.md says release tags are annotated, but release.yml creates lightweight tags (v0.13.1, v0.14.0, v0.15.0)
